UNION ALL SELECT 'total-cntr' AS ID, '총기부현황(건)' AS LABEL, count(*) AS `COUNT` FROM G_CNTR

choose.when: select NVL(CNTR_AMT,0)/1000 as CNTR_AMT ,to_char(to_date(CNTR_DAY,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')as CNTR_DAY from ( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-6,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-5,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-3,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD')as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY ) A , (SELECT sum(CAST(CNTR_AMT AS bigint)) as CNTR_AMT , CNTR_DE FROM g_cntr where sttemnt_pay_de is not null and delete_at ='N' and cntr_sttus_code ='200' group by CNTR_DE) B where A.CNTR_DAY =B.CNTR_DE(+)
choose.otherwise: select NVL(CNTR_AMT,0)/1000 as CNTR_AMT ,to_char(to_date(CNTR_DAY,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')as CNTR_DAY from ( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-6,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-5,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-3,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD')as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY ) A , (SELECT sum(CAST(CNTR_AMT AS bigint)) as CNTR_AMT , CNTR_DE FROM g_cntr where CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCd} and sttemnt_pay_de is not null and delete_at ='N' and cntr_sttus_code ='200' group by CNTR_DE) B where A.CNTR_DAY =B.CNTR_DE(+)

choose.when: select nvl(CNTR_AMT,0) as CNTR_AMT ,to_char(to_date(CNTR_DAY,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')as CNTR_DAY from ( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-6,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-5,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-3,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD')as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY ) A , (SELECT count(CNTR_AMT) as CNTR_AMT , CNTR_DE FROM g_cntr where sttemnt_pay_de is not null and delete_at ='N' and cntr_sttus_code ='200' group by CNTR_DE) B where A.CNTR_DAY =B.CNTR_DE(+)
choose.otherwise: select nvl(CNTR_AMT,0) as CNTR_AMT ,to_char(to_date(CNTR_DAY,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')as CNTR_DAY from ( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-6,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-5,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-3,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD')as CNTR_DAY union select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') as CNTR_DAY ) A , (SELECT count(CNTR_AMT) as CNTR_AMT , CNTR_DE FROM g_cntr where CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCd} and sttemnt_pay_de is not null and delete_at ='N' and cntr_sttus_code ='200' group by CNTR_DE) B where A.CNTR_DAY =B.CNTR_DE(+)

UNION ALL SELECT 'online-prj-cntramt' AS ID, '온라인 지정기부 금액' AS LABEL, IFNULL(SUM(CAST(CNTR_AMT AS BIGINT)), 0) AS `COUNT` FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT ='N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND CNTR_DE >= CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{shCntrDeStart}, 1, 4), '0101') AND CNTR_DE <= #{shCntrDeStart} AND ( DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID <> 0 AND DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID IS NOT NULL )
UNION ALL SELECT 'offline-cntramt' AS ID, '오프라인 일반기부 금액' AS LABEL, IFNULL(SUM(CAST(CNTR_AMT AS BIGINT)), 0) AS `COUNT` FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT ='N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND CNTR_PATH_CODE IN ('200', '300') AND CNTR_DE >= CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{shCntrDeStart}, 1, 4), '0101') AND CNTR_DE <= #{shCntrDeStart} AND ( DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = 0 OR DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID IS NULL )
UNION ALL SELECT 'offline-prj-cntramt' AS ID, '오프라인 지정기부 금액' AS LABEL, IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT), 0) AS `COUNT` FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT ='N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND CNTR_PATH_CODE IN ('200', '300') AND CNTR_DE >= CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{shCntrDeStart}, 1, 4), '0101') AND CNTR_DE <= #{shCntrDeStart} AND ( DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID <> 0 AND DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID IS NOT NULL )
UNION ALL SELECT 'total-present' AS ID, '총답례품현황(건)' AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS `COUNT` FROM ( SELECT ORDER_CODE FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT WHERE USE_SE_CODE = '1' AND POINT_USE_DE >= CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{shCntrDeStart}, 1, 4), '0101') AND POINT_USE_DE <= #{shCntrDeStart} GROUP BY ORDER_CODE ) WHERE 1=1
UNION ALL SELECT 'total-presentamt' AS ID, (SELECT CONCAT('(',UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ,' ', LOCGOV_NM, ')') FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCd}) AS LABEL, IFNULL(SUM(CAST(CNTR_USE_POINT AS BIGINT)), 0) AS `SUM` FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT WHERE USE_SE_CODE = '1' AND POINT_USE_DE >= CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{shCntrDeStart}, 1, 4), '0101') AND POINT_USE_DE <= #{shCntrDeStart}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT_DASHBOARD ( ON_CNTR_CNT, ON_CNTR_AMT, OFF_CNTR_CNT, OFF_CNTR_AMT, PRESENT_CNT, PRESENT_AMT, CALL_KOOKMIN, CALL_LOV, CALL_GIVER, CALL_NHBANK, CALL_AMT, PRESENT, TOTAL_CNTR, TOTAL_CNTRAMT, TOTAL_USER, CREATED_DATE, ON_CNTR_PRJ_CNT, ON_CNTR_PRJ_AMT, OFF_CNTR_PRJ_CNT, OFF_CNTR_PRJ_AMT ) VALUES ( #{online-cntr}, #{online-cntramt}, #{offline-cntr}, #{offline-cntramt}, #{total-present}, #{total-presentamt}, #{callKookmin}, #{callLov}, #{callGiver}, #{callNhbank}, #{callAmt}, #{present}, #{total-cntr}, #{total-cntramt}, #{userAmt}, #{createdDate}, #{online-prj-cntr}, #{online-prj-cntramt}, #{offline-prj-cntr}, #{offline-prj-cntramt} )
mapper.select: SELECT *, total_cntramt - (SELECT total_cntramt FROM REPORT_DASHBOARD WHERE created_date = #{shCntrDeEnd}) as totalCntrAmtCal, total_cntr - (SELECT total_cntr FROM REPORT_DASHBOARD WHERE created_date = #{shCntrDeEnd}) as totalCntrCal FROM REPORT_DASHBOARD WHERE created_date = #{shCntrDeStart} ORDER BY REPORT_CREATEDATE DESC LIMIT 1
